constraints: Use only generated toy prime-field curves and synthetic targets.

research_question.decision_target: Decide whether any tested coordinate-defined factor base merits a larger, multi-seed decomposition and preprocessing study.
research_question.motivation: Concrete coordinate predicates and recursive addition-law sets are not closed by generic-group density bounds. Their additive energy, sumset compression, decomposition occupancy, and fixed-curve online tradeoffs can be measured directly.
